role: Fourth independent audit; first conclusions formed before reading other reports

observations.finding: Every successful session has exactly four rrweb input events in order name, phone, email, purpose; all 85 unsuccessful sessions have zero input events.
observations.implication: Failures are before typing; there is no evidence of errors completing individual fields.

observations.finding: CTA median timestamp is 42.1105 seconds for successful sessions, 46.7525 seconds for CTA failures. Success range36.814–56.805 seconds; failure33.346–55.185 seconds.
observations.implication: Distributions overlap; shorter journey is not established as the mechanism of E03 improvement.

observations.finding: All101 DOM snapshots contain the same six module word counts [108,106,111,105,100,104], four CTAs, four required fields and expected absolute api/submit.php action. No form_invalid events occur.
observations.implication: Version/field-contract differences and recorded native validation errors do not explain outcomes in this batch.

observations.finding: Successful -agMYq0ksx8_F2z9Vqqsbab_ scrolls to y6113, then y237, then y7573 around CTA; failed -8fHbbA6iM6Ro6SsM2MOWkwk scrolls to6688, then237, then7573.
observations.implication: The hero source indicates DOM button identity, not early decision or first-screen conversion.

observations.finding: Initial DOM contains634 words in the six program modules. Local Chrome iframe with exact1280x720 viewport measures program-list1719px and full program-section2081px, page8371px.
observations.implication: Program takes roughly2.4 viewport heights plus intro/padding; reducing reading volume is testable, but consumption/causality remains unknown.
observations.validation_limit: Local reconstructed current HTML/CSS, not exact replay screenshot; top-level Chrome viewport resize did not take effect, so iframe viewport was used and explicitly verified.

observations.finding: Program/feature/injury cards use pointer cursor and hover translation despite no corresponding action listeners in main.js. One no-CTA session has repeated card-target clicks at0,0.
observations.implication: False affordance is a genuine code issue; the coordinates are not sufficient evidence that human confusion caused this loss.
observations.confidence: high on code, low on conversion effect

alternative_explanations: Sequential batches may differ by scenario/persona mix or random outcomes. 10%→16% is not randomized causal evidence.
The repeated deep scroll then jump to the first CTA is consistent with scripted selection. This does not prove intent or a specific simulator scoring rule.
Decision not to begin filling can reflect perceived burden, trust, value, time or predetermined scenario behavior; event stream alone cannot separate these.
Required field count is fixed by challenge and zero unsuccessful input does not justify disabling validation or auto-filling values.

experiments_ranked.name: Short program copy
experiments_ranked.change: Rewrite each of six existing modules to30–45 outcome-focused words, keeping schedule, module count/classes and section order. No accordions or hidden text.
experiments_ranked.hypothesis: Long descriptive modules increase perceived reading cost before registration.
experiments_ranked.prediction: More sessions start genuine input after CTA and complete an order; if physical reading path matters, less pre-CTA time/depth.
diagnostics: Unique rrweb input sessions / CTA sessions
Compare same sample patterns across batches
experiments_ranked.confidence: medium-to-low causal; strongest permitted content candidate

experiments_ranked.name: Remove false affordances
experiments_ranked.change: Set cursor default and remove hover lift only for non-action program/feature/injury cards, preserving elements/classes.
experiments_ranked.hypothesis: Non-interactive cards invite wasted action and reduce clarity.
experiments_ranked.prediction: Fewer in-viewport non-action clicks, lower exit rate before CTA, higher confirmed conversion.
experiments_ranked.diagnostic_guard: Do not count offscreen or programmatic0,0/html clicks as behavioral confusion.
experiments_ranked.confidence: low conversion effect; code defect clear

experiments_ranked.name: Decision clarity at form
experiments_ranked.change: Within registration section show a concise recap of existing course price/format and confirmation process, and make submit visually primary. Keep four mandatory fields and all submission logic intact.
experiments_ranked.hypothesis: Visitors reach a generic lead form without sufficient context to decide to begin.
experiments_ranked.prediction: Higher true first-input rate after registration_view; field completion rate may remain similar.
experiments_ranked.confidence: low-to-medium; follows observed pre-input loss but cannot separate motive
experiments_ranked.guard: Use only existing truthful details; do not promise no payment, no spam or a new date without business confirmation.

quality_limits: 101 tracker page sessions versus100 simulator visits; extra session attribution is unavailable.
All views1280x720; no evidence about real mobile behavior.
Focus name is automatic, not user engagement; input events and physical field clicks are stronger start signals.
A DOM snapshot plus event stream is not a video of intention.
Fixed15August2026 course date predates current23October2026 environment date; actual next course schedule is unknown. Correct only from true business data, never invent future date.
Recorded action client coordinates can be clipped; use raw rrweb positions/hit targets when judging offscreen clicks.
